description: Proposed relationships between buyers, engineering and assurance owners, service users and internal delivery coordination.

relationTypes.name: Accountable handoff
relationTypes.description: Evidence and decision rights exchanged across a responsibility boundary.

relations.name: Sets the funded outcome and acceptance boundary
relations.description: The sponsor sets investment constraints; the product owner returns user evidence and scope decisions.

relations.name: Agrees usable behavior and technical contracts
relations.description: The product owner supplies task outcomes; the architect makes integration and migration constraints explicit.

relations.name: Defines evidence and change obligations
relations.description: The client quality lead owns required evidence and approval responsibilities; engineers return testable implementations.

relations.name: Reviews knowledge use and AI behavior
relations.description: The AI owner supplies approved content and evaluations; competent client quality roles decide intended-use and release implications.

relations.name: Supplies usability and recovery evidence
relations.description: Representative users reveal task barriers and support needs through appropriately scoped research and feedback.

relations.name: Hands over a recoverable application
relations.description: Engineers provide tested contracts, deployed versions and runbooks; operations verifies restoration and support coverage.

relations.name: Feeds incidents into product improvement
relations.description: Operations provides user-impact and recurrence evidence; the client product owner prioritizes funded changes.

relations.name: Makes realistic delivery and lifecycle commitments
relations.description: The engagement lead makes skill and capacity constraints visible before client funding or milestone commitments.

relations.name: Verifies service continuity at renewal or exit
relations.description: The operations owner demonstrates receiver readiness and unresolved obligations before the sponsor approves transfer.
